### News

**01/20/25**     Our paper, *Seeing Eye to AI ?*, is accepted to CHI 2025 at 🎡!

I am a Ph.D. candidate at [Northwestern University](https://www.northwestern/edu/), fortunate to be advised by Professor [Matthew Kay](https://www.mjskay.com/) at [Mu Collective](https://mucollective.northwestern.edu/).

Before joining Northwestern, I was a student at [William & Mary](https://www.wm.edu/), where I majored in Computer Science and Economics.

## Research

My research focuses on developing theoretical frameworks and empirical tools to better understand how people reason about and interact with abstract visual information. I had also worked on questions that involve more economics and fairness concerns previously.

My CV is [here](grad_cv.pdf).
